crossRefs.note: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing…
but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his…
But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at…
You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride. You have ravished my heart with one of your eyes, with one chain of…
Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes…

translations.web: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
translations.bsb: Do not lust in your heart for her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes.
translations.kjv: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
translations.asv: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; Neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
